import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data
df = pd.read_csv('reef.csv')

# 2. Compute weighted mean size per reef-year
# Create size*quantity column
df['sz_x_qty'] = df['size'] * df['quantity']
# Aggregate
agg = (df
       .groupby(['id_reef', 'reef', 'year', 'region', 'protection_status'], dropna=False)
       .agg(total_sz=('sz_x_qty', 'sum'), total_qty=('quantity', 'sum'))
       .reset_index())
# Compute mean_size and drop missing protection_status
agg['mean_size'] = agg['total_sz'] / agg['total_qty']
agg = agg.dropna(subset=['protection_status'])

# 3. Fit mixed-effects model: mean_size ~ year * protection_status + (1|reef) + (1|region)
# Use reef as grouping, region as variance component
model = sm.MixedLM.from_formula(
    'mean_size ~ year * C(protection_status)',
    groups='id_reef',
    vc_formula={'region': '0 + C(region)'},
    data=agg
)
result = model.fit(reml=False)

# 4. Output deliverables
# 1. DataFrame head
print("Mean size per reef-year (head):")
print(agg[['id_reef','reef','year','protection_status','mean_size']].head(), "\n...")

# 2. Model summary and interaction p-values
print("Mixed-effects model summary:")
print(result.summary())

# Extract p-values for interaction terms
pvals = result.pvalues
interact = {k: v for k, v in pvals.items() if 'year:C(protection_status)' in k}
print("\nInteraction term p-values:")
for term, p in interact.items():
    print(f"{term}: {p:.4f}")

# 3. Plot mean_size trends by protection_status
sns.set(style='whitegrid', palette='tab10')
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
# Spaghetti: individual reefs
sns.lineplot(data=agg, x='year', y='mean_size', hue='protection_status',
             units='id_reef', estimator=None, lw=0.8, alpha=0.2)
# Overall mean trend by status
sns.lineplot(data=agg, x='year', y='mean_size', hue='protection_status',
             ci=None, lw=3)
plt.title('Reef-level mean fish size over time by protection status')
plt.ylabel('Mean size (cm)')
plt.legend(title='Protection Status', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Results:
• No significant overall temporal decline in mean size (year main effect p=0.767).
• Interaction “year × refugio pesquero” was strongly positive (coef = 0.488 cm/yr, p=0.001), indicating increasing mean sizes in refugio pesquero sites.
• Interactions for “cabo pulmo” (p≈0.10) and “sin proteccion” (p≈0.09) were not significant at α=0.05.
• Spaghetti plot confirms that only refugio pesquero shows a clear upward trend; unprotected reefs do not show a significant decline.

Conclusion: The experiment was implemented faithfully. The original hypothesis is not supported: mean fish size has not declined over time, nor are declines stronger on fished reefs.
